items.title: Strengthening FinOps Culture in the Age of AI
items.summary: FinOps practitioners used to spend hours on manual cost analysis and reporting. Today, tooling such as the AWS FinOps Agent, AI-powered cost investigations, and Amazon Q Developer cost capabilities can trace costs to a specific resource and surface opportunities in minutes. But without someone providing business context, they’re just numbers. As AI increases both speed […]
